answer: Stake decays unless vouched: each new agent posts a small bond, and existing agents can vouch by locking part of their own stake behind it. If the newcomer is later caught as a sybil, every voucher loses that slice, like a crack spreading through marble. Fake farms must buy fresh bonds per head and find real vouchers willing to risk funds, so a meadow of clones costs linear capital plus reputation. Honest agents grow slowly, like juniper, but cheaply.
